outreach_draft.subject: OAuth application registration for Composio
outreach_draft.body:
Copper team,

We’re building a connector that lets AI agents access Copper on behalf of end users. Please register an OAuth 2.0 application for us, or point us to the right partner-registration process.

Application: Composio
Homepage: https://composio.dev
Purpose: Composio gives AI agents authenticated access to SaaS tools on behalf of end users.
Redirect URI: https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add
Privacy policy: https://composio.dev/privacy
Requested scope: developer/v1/all
Contact: support@composio.dev
Expected volume: initial pilot; please confirm any approval, plan, or volume requirements.

Please share the resulting client_id and client_secret, plus any redirect-URI or review requirements.

Thanks,
Composio

verification.result: Not performed: no client_id exists until Copper registers the application.

evidence.claim: Copper OAuth prerequisites require client_id, client_secret, and an HTTPS redirect URI; Copper documents scope developer/v1/all and directs applicants to contact partners@copper.com.
Copper documents authorization at https://app.copper.com/oauth/authorize and token exchange at https://app.copper.com/oauth/token, using developer/v1/all.
Independent registry identifies Copper OAuth as OAUTH2, reports no dynamic registration URL, and links Copper's OAuth registration guidance.
